about_the_game:
KNOWN FEATURES //

  • Multiplayer pick up and play FPS action

  • So many guns, it'll make your head spin

  • Maps you wanna spend time and live in

  • Character cast includes frogmen, humans, aliens, robots, and a mech riding cat

  • Super satisfying movement with sliding down hills 

  • Aesthetic Sleek Style built to look amazing but also readable without clutter

  • Every map has a bathroom

  • Drink sugary soda from vending machines scattered around maps for health

  • Blow up sodamachines, make cans fly all over map & reduce enemy's chance of drinking

  • Arcade machines to play full arcade games! Watch your back though, other players may still shoot you while you're taking an arcade break.

  • Destructable stuff like lights, windows, toilets, cars

KNOWN WEAPONS //

  • Nade-balla - fire a Nadeball that rolls and remotely detonates

  • U22i - chunky loud submachine gun, not too accurate

  • NRG Streamer - weapon of unknown origin that shoots a constant energy stream

  • Acid Nozzle - high-powered watergun that shoots face-melting acid 

  • Laser Pistol - bounce lasers off the wall with this alien weapon

  • G.T.A.R. - guitar Type Audio Rifle. Shatter your opponents with guitar riffs

  • Refiner - trusty Semi-futuristic powerful revolver

  • Fireworx - shoot fireworks, but don't get distracted by the beautiful explosion

  • P77 - experimental submachine gun. accurate, but small clip

  • Cybergun - fast accurate firing pistol

  • Discodeathball - wildy innaccurate spinning multi-colored laser gatling gun

  • Railgun - 1 shot kill, but has to charge

  • Cointoss - a shiny silenced shotgun

  • tons more

KNOWN MAPS //

  • Area 57 - a remote research facility 

  • Resort - sunny tropical hotel with pools and boat tour

  • Mall - abandoned retro style mall

  • Metropolis - waterfront courtyard and surrounding buildings

  • Foundation - headquarters building

  • Mothership - this vessel has been floating through space for centuries

NOTES //

All info in this page subject to change. Game currently uses listen servers for online play. Photosensitive Seizure warning. Game is currently Multiplayer only.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows® 7 (or higher) 64 Bit
  • Processor: AMD FX-4350, 4.2 GHz / Intel Core i5-3450, 3.10 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon HD 6870, 1 GB / GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 1 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
